subject: Intro & availability: 30m product preview + stakeholder options
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Thompson <mike@averytech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & availability: 30m product preview + stakeholder options

Thanks again for the time this morning, Mike — appreciated the candid walkthrough of AveryTech's priorities. Quick recap and a couple of suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

- What we heard: primary use-case is low-latency inference for customer-facing workflows, data residency concerns for EU customers, and a desire to measure unit cost across a 6–8 week pilot.
- Open items: expected throughput (p50/p95), primary security contacts, and success criteria for an initial pilot.

Next step: a short 30-minute product preview that brings the engineering owner + one exec to see how Redwood's serving runtime maps to AveryTech's SLAs. Below are three times that work for our team (all PT):

Option A — Tue Oct 7, 10:00–10:30 PT (Vivek, Karthik available)
Option B — Wed Oct 8, 14:00–14:30 PT (Vivek, Neha available)
Option C — Thu Oct 9, 08:30–09:00 PT (Vivek available; good if you have a morning slot)

If none of these fit, tell me a pair of 30-minute windows that work on your side and we’ll adapt. Also proposing an optional follow-up 60-minute technical deep-dive (engineering + infra) the week after for any folks who want to dig into quantization, KV-cache, and autoscaling patterns.

I’ve attached a short discovery notes PDF and a Mutual Action Plan draft for your review — quick asks are highlighted.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Mike Thompson <mike@averytech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@averytech.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & availability: 30m product preview + stakeholder options

Vivek — thanks for the summary and the materials. Good alignment on scope; I pulled in Laura (our Head of Engineering) and she asked that our security lead sit in for the overview so we can triage any early assurance questions. 

Quick note on times: Wed Oct 8 at 14:00 PT might clash with a board review for Laura. Could you do the following instead?

- Tues Oct 7, 11:00–11:30 PT (one hour later than A)
- Wed Oct 8, 09:30–10:00 PT (morning window)

If you can hold both tentatively, we’ll confirm later today. Also, can you include a one-paragraph note in the MAP that outlines what data flows look like during a Hosted API pilot? That will help our procurement team.

Thanks — Mike

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Thompson <mike@averytech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & availability: 30m product preview + stakeholder options

Thanks Mike — appreciate the quick reply and the heads-up on stakeholders.

We can hold two tentatives while you confirm:

Refined Option 1 — Tue Oct 7, 11:00–11:30 PT (Vivek + Karthik)
Refined Option 2 — Wed Oct 8, 09:30–10:00 PT (Vivek + Neha)

If Laura or your security lead prefers a different cadence, no problem — we can also run the 30-minute preview with exec + product and then schedule the 60-minute technical deep-dive for engineers only (we recommend 60–90 minutes for the deep-dive). For the Mutual Action Plan, I appended a short paragraph under "Pilot Data Flows" describing expected ingress/egress for a hosted API pilot and where logs are retained. See the attached MAP v1.1.

Next asks from our side to speed procurement: 
- Can your security lead confirm preferred evidence format for data residency (SAML/SOC2 artifacts, IP ranges)?
- Who will be the procurement contact for billing/contract?

If you confirm Option 1 or 2, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30 minutes: 10m exec overview, 15m demo, 5m next steps).

Best — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mike Thompson <mike@averytech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@averytech.com>, AveryTech Security <security@averytech.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & availability: 30m product preview + stakeholder options

Vivek — Option 1 (Tue Oct 7, 11:00–11:30 PT) works for us. Laura will be there and I’ve looped in Priya (security@averytech.com) to handle the evidence checklist. Procurement contact is me for now (I’ll loop finance once we get to MAP sign-off).

Please send the invite + agenda. Looking forward to the demo.

— Mike
